fixed_cross_site_geometry.different_gaia_quality: for DIFFERENT_GAIA mutual pairs, report both-Gaia-distance<=1arcsec and whether cross-site pair separation is smaller than each detection's own Gaia-match distance; no pair is promoted
fixed_cross_site_geometry.pairing: mutual nearest neighbour between all strict-HQ common-footprint detections on the two science exposures
fixed_cross_site_geometry.same_gaia_identity_geometry: for every Gaia identity present on both sides, measure the minimum cross-site detection separation for that identity and bin using the same fixed angular thresholds

input_population.common_footprint: recompute exactly using the two frozen selected solution polygons and the v094i gnomonic point-in-polygon method
input_population.source_cache: exact 1,386 v094i strict-HQ (scan_id, solution_num) NPZ products, hash-inventoried before v094j freeze
input_population.strict_hq_definition_inherited: model_prediction >= 0.9 AND sextractor_flags = 0; no threshold change in v094j

interpretive_stop: Interpret whether strict-HQ cross-site structure is overwhelmingly same-Gaia, contains a material different-Gaia mutual-pair population, or is dominated by weak/ambiguous Gaia associations. Only after this stop may a prospectively frozen physical-parallax or source-quality-sensitivity stage be designed.

known_at_freeze.interpretation_boundary: The zero Gaia-unresolved result is a null only for the frozen strict-HQ branch. APPLAUSE source_calib itself does not require a Gaia match, so v094j must assess the quality and geometry of the Gaia associations already present rather than treating all Gaia IDs as dispositive.

purpose: Interpret the completed v094i strict-HQ <=5 minute source-state census without inspecting individual sources. Quantify Gaia association quality and cross-site mutual-nearest-neighbour geometry among all strict-HQ sources already acquired by v094i, separating same-Gaia from different-Gaia pairings before any candidate inspection, physical parallax modelling, control search, pixels, registration, or threshold relaxation.
